latestVersion.changelog:
Attestation Root Diversity Analyzer 1.0.0

- Initial release of the attestation root diversity analyzer.
- Analyzes skill attestation graphs to assess root concentration and monoculture risk.
- Reports on five dimensions: root concentration index, self-attestation, organizational diversity, effective validator count, and structural fragility.
- Provides clear verdicts (DISTRIBUTED, CONCENTRATED, MONOCULTURE, SELF-ATTESTING) and actionable recommendations.
- Designed to highlight concealed centralization and improve trust transparency in skill ecosystems.
